_provenance: Hand-written by the maintainer on 2026-08-24 for M054, AC2. Deliberately produced by no package function and regenerated by no data-raw script: its job is to prove that a descriptor the package did not write reads back correctly, which a generated fixture cannot do. The scale names are the camelCase stems rather than the display names write_module() writes, and the three advisory fields (package, packageVersion, buildDate) are omitted, so this file also exercises the format's optional parts. The item numbers were read from hitopsr_scales$itemNumbers for the two scales named below. Fields this package does not know, such as this one, are ignored on read.
